hook: Hyderabad 24K gold is *30%* below its January record
hook_b: Hyderabad 24K gold is *30%* below its January record
tldr: On Nov 20, 10 grams of 24-carat gold cost ₹1,25,570 and 22-carat ₹1,15,100 in Hyderabad, down from ₹1,78,850 and ₹1,63,950 on the Jan 29 record. Siasat links the fall to a stronger US dollar, high bond yields and expected tighter US Fed policy.

beats.what: Gold in Hyderabad is ₹53,280 per 10 g cheaper than the Jan 29, 2026 record.
beats.why: A stronger US dollar, high bond yields and expectations of tighter US Fed policy are pulling prices down.
beats.care: Wedding-season buyers pay less now than in January; anyone who bought at the peak is sitting on a loss.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Siasat (Nov 20): MCX gold December futures fell as much as 4.49% to ₹1,21,719 per 10 g by 10:30 am.

cards.q: With gold down 30% from its peak, what would you do?

qs: How much of the fall is the US dollar versus local demand?
Do jewellers pass the full price drop to buyers?

facts.t: Spot gold slipped below *USD 3,550* an ounce after trading near USD 3,630.
JPMorgan forecasts *USD 6,300* an ounce by Q4 2027; Goldman Sachs USD 5,400 by end-2027.

viz.verdict: Cheaper for buyers, a loss for those who bought at the peak

watch: The next US Federal Reserve meeting, where a rate hike is expected, per Siasat.

sources.title: Gold prices tumble in Hyderabad: Is it time to buy?

fact: Hyderabad's 24-carat gold fell to *₹1,25,570* per 10 grams, nearly 30% below January's record
twist: Silver fell even harder on Friday: MCX December futures dropped 6.6%, or ₹10,416 per kg, in a day.
